incident_spec.summary: Investigating the performance and concurrency behavior of large transactions in PostgreSQL.
symptoms: Blocked transactions when two sessions attempt to update the same row.
Potential deadlocks or serialization errors depending on isolation levels.
incident_spec.mechanism: PostgreSQL's MVCC (Multiversion Concurrency Control) ensures that reads do not block writes and vice versa, but concurrent writes to the same rows can lead to blocking or errors.
